claims.text: Roque describes a negotiated fort at Sofala involving Yusuf, Pedro de Anaia and local materials, knowledge and labour. OpenStax describes soldiers replacing Kilwa’s ruler and subsequent factional conflict. Shipping restrictions and merchants’ resistance further distinguish the relationships. A Portuguese establishment did not erase existing political or trading agency, establish full coastal control or prove popular consent. These are mediated accounts; the requested letter body was not acquired.
